crossRefs.note: All who lived at Lydda and in Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.
The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.
This became known to all, both Jews and Greeks, who lived at Ephesus. Fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord…
Many also of those who had believed came, confessing, and declaring their deeds.
But when Jesus heard it, he said, “This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God’s Son may be…
Therefore many of the Jews who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did believed in him.
because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.
Jesus cried out and said, “Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.

people.name: Joppa
people.line: An ancient seaport, the main port for Jerusalem

translations.web: This became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.
translations.bsb: This became known all over Joppa, and many people believed in the Lord.
translations.kjv: And it was known throughout all Joppa; and many believed in the Lord.
translations.asv: And it became known throughout all Joppa: and many believed on the Lord.
